metaTitle: WebP Explained: Why This Modern Format Matters for Websites
metaDescription: Learn what WebP is, why it is efficient for web delivery, and when converting to PNG or JPG is the better choice.

guideContent.section1Title: Why WebP is useful for responsive websites
guideContent.section1Body: WebP is one of the most practical modern image formats for websites because it often delivers strong quality at smaller file sizes. It is especially useful for imagery that needs fast loading and efficient delivery across modern browsers.
guideContent.section2Title: When WebP is not the best final format
guideContent.section2Body: WebP is not always the most convenient choice for every downstream workflow. Designers, editors, and teams that need traditional compatibility may prefer PNG or JPG for a later stage of the workflow.
steps: Use WebP when site speed and efficient delivery matter most.
Convert to PNG when transparency and editing flexibility matter more than size.
Convert to JPG when the image is photographic and a standard compatibility workflow is needed.

faqs.question: Is WebP good for websites?
faqs.answer: Yes. WebP is widely used because it often produces smaller files without a dramatic loss in visual quality.

faqs.question: Should I always use WebP?
faqs.answer: Not always. Some workflows need PNG or JPG because of editing needs or compatibility expectations.

faqs.question: Can I convert WebP without uploading files?
faqs.answer: Yes. The tool works locally in the browser so the file stays private.
